purpose: Diagnose output suppression versus public representation using complete training games only. No candidate promotion or policy learning.
loss: Absolute error with unchanged episode/reached-phase weights
epoch_selection: Fixed final epoch; no tuning to held-out training-fold labels.
evaluation: All out-of-fold phase representative predictions retained. Report pooled and per-fold/phase/seat/style gains, training fit and correction magnitude. Do not choose a model from an aggregate concealing late regressions.
decision_rule: Report every family fold, phase and style against the corrected globals baseline. Improvement confined to pooled scores does not justify candidate freeze. Preserve final acceptance thresholds and unopened evaluation data.
scope: Training-only representation diagnostic. Test whether visible unit mechanics and positions reduce the downward regulation-margin bias seen with public globals. All corrected corpora, family exclusions, optimizer, hidden width, epochs, seeds and fixed overtime race are unchanged. No model promotion. The fixed overtime component cannot be repaired by this representation comparison.
